Shifting Gears Women's Mountain Bike Ride

Bellingham, WA · Mountain bike

Women / trans / femmeBeginner friendlyNo-drop

Shifting Gears Women's Mountain Bike Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Bellingham, WA. It rolls every Monday at 5:30 pm from Galbraith Mountain or Lake Padden trailheads (varies weekly). Pace: beginner-friendly, small groups. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: beginner-friendly, small groups. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @letsshiftgears the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Shifting Gears Women's Mountain Bike Ride group ride

A weekly Monday evening trail ride for women 18 and up, whatever their experience, body size or nerves. Groups are capped at eight riders with two leaders. Rides go on Galbraith Mountain or at Lake Padden. Register ahead; sign-ups open two weeks before each ride.
